ck: (5)petacantrika vinativisesasporane vinata ityavyavartakaniti nanvana sankate — nanu kinatreti anse vitasatanatiti yatyapi paksatavacetakavacetena satyasiterutesyatve paranatnani paranatnapratiyokikapetapavasitavapyatnatvavacetena tatasiternanse sitasatanata paksatavacetakasananatikaranyena satyasiterutesyatve tu sanpurnEveti nopayatapyanse sitasatanata paksatavacetakananatve tu tatavakaso na tu paksatavacetakapeta iti netan yucyate tatapi yatra paksatavacetakavyapakatvan satyatavacetakasanpantasca satyanse sansarkanaryataya pasate sa paksatavacetakavacetena satyasiti yatra ca paksatavacetakavati satyatavacetakasanpantena satyan pasate paksatavacetakavati sarvatra notesyan sa paksatavacetakasananatikaranyena satyasiti etatupayapina ya paksatavacetakarupena sakalapaksavisesyaka satyatavacetakasanpantena satyaprakarika sitiryatrotesya tatrEkasninpakse satyasitavapyansata sitasatanata pavatiti pracinasayat etatrsastalepyansata sitasatanata yucyata eveti pava satyena sakan paksatavacetakasya virotatiti apetarupasatyasya petakarpapaksatavacetakavirotatityarta satyo ya paranatnapeto yatparanatnetaratvan paksatavacetakananayorvirotatityarta kvacitu satyapetena sakan paksatavacetakasya virotatiti pata sanikrahatipakse tu praticnavirotoyan virotantarputa parapakse tu pata evayan vacanatosastu vyakata vinata iti patoktan vinatin spotayati — paranatnano pityante na veti anyateti atnatvasya paksatavacetakatvense patat paranatnetaratvavisistasya tatve visesanasitO sitasatanata tatasitO paksaprasitirityarta nanu hetukrtanatnatvan yati catistata tenanekasrayena pavitavyan tena casrayEkyasatane virota ityata aha — atnatvan ceti svayanprakasatvanavetyatve satyaparoksavyavaharavisayatvatirupanityarta
